description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Egypt Egypt 2026 official public-holiday layer for ministries, government bodies, public authorities, local administration and public-sector/public-business companies result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the official nationwide public-holiday layer published for Egyptian government/public-sector scope. Private employers, banks, schools, diplomatic missions, exchanges, local or sector calendars may differ and are not inferred. Friday-Saturday is the ordinary weekend baseline; special remote-work or operating-hour decisions are not treated as holidays. Islamic dates and later Prime Minister decisions require a refreshed package.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Friday-Saturday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Egypt: Eid al-Fitr public holiday. | Egypt: Ordinary Egypt working day.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-03-20"} | {"date":"2026-09-14"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Friday/Saturday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/egypt-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/egypt-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Egypt's pinned 2026 official public-holiday coverage over a Friday-Saturday weekend.

name: check_eg_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Egypt 2026 official public-holiday layer for ministries, government bodies, public authorities, local administration and public-sector/public-business companies

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Egypt Working Day
